name: Holy Diver
summary: A Darnassian seeks your help stopping naga from controlling sea creatures near the Ruins of Mathystra. Find their beastmistress and recover the tool used to compel the creatures.

sections.title: A Beastmistress's Rod
sections.body: A Darnassian asks you to stop the naga in the Ruins of Mathystra, where they are seizing threshers from the shore. Animal samples showed that the naga forced sea creatures to serve as mounts and beasts of burden. Those they could not use were driven away. Find the Stormscale Beastmistress and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion; the creatures remain under the naga's control until it is taken.

sections.title: The Creatures' Peace
sections.body: In the Ruins of Mathystra, you take the Rod of Deep Dominion from the naga. The Darnassian says it will be destroyed, so the threshers and sea turtles can live in peace.

faq.q: What are the naga doing to the sea creatures?
faq.answer: The naga compel sea creatures to serve as mounts and beasts of burden, and drive away those they cannot use.
The naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra.
A Stormscale Beastmistress is the target named by the Darnassian.

faq.q: What is the Rod of Deep Dominion?
faq.answer: It is the rod the naga use to compel sea creatures into their service.
The Darnassian names threshers and sea turtles as creatures that can live in peace once the rod is destroyed.
